images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. A single 16:9 widescreen first frame for an absurd Korean live-action miniature tokusatsu disaster comedy, no collage, no words, no logo.
Scene S01: extremely low-angle wide shot outside a fictional modest Korean institutional gymnasium in ominous stormy backlight. A threatening original RED long-necked monster stands upright on the LEFT beside the gym's independent rectangular entrance canopy on the RIGHT. Monster upright height 8 meters; the separate canopy soffit is 5 meters; the gym behind it is 12 meters tall. Perspective makes monster imposing but never changes these dimensions. Canopy flat horizontal pale concrete slab supported by FOUR slender square gray columns; all four intact. It is a free standing four-post porch in front of the taller gray gym, NOT the gym's main roof. Door in gym behind porch.
MONSTER DESIGN LOCK: an obviously fabricated miniature special-effects rubber puppet, not human or photoreal animal, not cute mascot. A very long thick flexible scarlet neck roughly half its full upright height, small block-shaped red torso, long thick red arms with simple four-finger mitt hands, two short stout square legs. Small rectangular red head, two round yellow inset eyes with tiny black pupils staring with arrogant menace, straight horizontal mouth slit slightly opening just before a roar, small half-circle red ears behind each side of head. Visible rough red rubber seams and painted texture, no scales or hair or horns. Both arms hang at body sides, knees straight, neck fully extended. Do not show neck folded yet. Keep this silhouette unmistakably strange and threatening. Heavy cloud sky, harsh practical rim light, miniature grass, concrete seams, distant small pedestrian woman in gray jacket and man in navy shirt outside porch for scale. Nobody underneath canopy. No destruction yet, no rubble, no ladder, no tools, no earphones. Composition reads monster, independent intact canopy and taller gym together. Grainy photographed physical models with cinematic contrast, not glossy CGI, not children's toy advertising.

notes: 직립한 긴 붉은 목과 노란 눈, 의도적 고무 인형 질감, 온전한 네 기둥 포치 확인. 행사 문구 없음.
